Axiom:
**Task-ID `-` is unique, semantic, and immutable.** The slug names the feature in 1-2 words, ≤ 8 characters — not a sequence number, not a paragraph.
- `sdd-new` generates and validates the ID — grammar, slug length, project-wide uniqueness (duplicate or prefix-conflict against every existing Task-ID). Never hand-roll the format: run `sdd-new task --id -` and let it refuse with a concrete fix if the id is bad. - Uniqueness is enforced by the **Slug Registry** in each `.3-tasks.md`: the same slug in two branches collides on merge there, surfacing «same feature» instead of hiding it. Append-only. - The ID never changes — even if the ticket file moves between scopes. - Code references via file headers (`@tasks:`) point to IDs, not paths. - `sdd-check` cross-checks integrity (SDD_TASK_ID_GRAMMAR, SDD_TASK_ID_PREFIX_CLASH, SDD_TASK_ID_COLLISION); a genuine collision → abort, operator resolves.
